samplingModel.estimator: independent sample mean or Hadamard-test real component
assumptions: state preparation and controlled insertion errors excluded
all target representatives are real at tau=i in the declared eta convention
J(i) normalization is known rather than separately sampled
no covariance advantage or common-random-number cancellation
